title: ziziphora majoranifolia
intro: Ziziphora majoranifolia, commonly known as yarrow-leafed marjoram, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. This herb is known for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as its potential to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphora majoranifolia include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents in this plant, including linalool and β-pinene, contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
